benefits: Offers email, SMS, and WhatsApp on a single platform
Provides a flexible data model for CRM with custom attributes and segmentation
Includes a generous free tier for building out features
Delivers clear, fair, and educational human support
frictions: Account protection process can be abrupt for first-time senders
Lack of clear warning before sending to high-risk lists
Self-service reactivation flow is initially confusing
API gaps for developer setups, such as inability to create forms or segments via API
